description: Get the current or latest sync job record: { jobId, state ("running" | "succeeded" | "failed"), total (null until scanning has counted the files on disk), completed (upserted + skipped + empty; pruned is counted separately), summary { upserted, skipped, empty, pruned }, warnings, error (null unless the job failed) }. An unknown jobId means the job was replaced by a newer one or lost with a previous server process.
name: sync_status
